traits.name: Ice Glide

Moving across or through difficult terrain composed of snow or ice does not cost it extra movement.

All creatures within range must make a DC 26 Constitution saving throw, taking 78 (12d12) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

options.name: Frost Prison
options.description: The dragon breathes a swirling mass of frost at a point within 300 feet of itself, which expands out into a cylinder that is 50 feet high with a 30 foot radius. All creatures in that area must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d12 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Creatures who succeed the save are pushed to an unoccupied space outside the cylinder. The cylinder then freezes into a block of ice, encasing all creatures that remain in the area. Each creature contained inside is restrained, takes 1d10 cold damage at the start of every turn they are trapped, has total cover, and cannot breathe. The ice is uneven and rough, causing impurities that leave the creatures inside blind to everything more than 10 feet away from them, and for everything in the ice to be heavily obscured. Every 10 foot cube of the cylinder has 18 AC, immunity to cold damage, vulnerability to fire damage, and 30 hit points.

Stat Blocks.raw_text:
**WHITE FEATHERED DRAGON**
*Gargantuan dragon (chromatic), chaotic evil*
**AC** 21 (natural armor)
**HP** 390 (20d20 + 180)
**Speed** 60 ft., fly 120 ft., swim 60 ft.
**STR** 26 (+8) | **DEX** 14 (+2) | **CON** 28 (+9) | **INT** 14 (+2) | **WIS** 16 (+3) | **CHA** 18 (+4)
**Saving Throws** Dex +9, Con +16, Wis +10, Cha +11
**Skills** Perception +17, Stealth +9
**Immunities** cold
**Condition Immunities** charmed, frightened, exhaustion
**Senses** truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 27
**Languages** Common, Draconic
**CR** 22 (41,000 XP) **Proficiency Bonus** +7

**TRAITS**
*Eidolic*

***Ice Glide.*** This dragon can magically pass through ice and snow as if it were swimming through water, leaving no opening in its wake, but it cannot end its turn fully encased within the frozen terrain. If it does, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes 1d8 force damage for every 10 feet it was shunted. Moving across or through difficult terrain composed of snow or ice does not cost it extra movement.

**LEGENDARY REACTIONS** (4 uses)
TBA

***Uncanny Frost.*** Cold damage from the dragon ignores resistances, and immunity to cold damage only reduces the damage to half instead. This does not apply to damage the dragon might deal to itself.

**ACTIONS**
***Multiattack.*** The dragon makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.

***Bite.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 18 (3d12) cold damage.

***Claw.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it is restrained and grappled (escape DC 20). While grappling a creature it cannot make Claw attacks except one each turn against the grappled creature.

***Tail.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (2d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed a DC 25 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

***Breath Weapon (Recharge 5-6).*** The dragon uses one of its breath weapon options (Blizzard Breath or Frost Prison).
• ***Blizzard Breath.*** The dragon exhales a sphere of frost at a point it can see within 300 feet of it, which explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere. All creatures within range must make a DC 26 Constitution saving throw, taking 78 (12d12) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
• ***Frost Prison.*** The dragon breathes a swirling mass of frost at a point within 300 feet of itself, which expands out into a cylinder that is 50 feet high with a 30 foot radius. All creatures in that area must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d12 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Creatures who succeed the save are pushed to an unoccupied space outside the cylinder. The cylinder then freezes into a block of ice, encasing all creatures that remain in the area. Each creature contained inside is restrained, takes 1d10 cold damage at the start of every turn they are trapped, has total cover, and cannot breathe. The ice is uneven and rough, causing impurities that leave the creatures inside blind to everything more than 10 feet away from them, and for everything in the ice to be heavily obscured. Every 10 foot cube of the cylinder has 18 AC, immunity to cold damage, vulnerability to fire damage, and 30 hit points.

**BONUS ACTIONS**
***Change Shape.*** The dragon transforms into any creature that is Medium, Small or Tiny, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size), though if it is Tiny it cannot use its multiattack. This transformation ends if the dragon is reduced to 0 hit points or uses a bonus action to end it.

**REACTIONS**
***Beyond the Web (Recharge 5-6).*** When one or more creatures within 120 feet of the feathered dragon is targeted by the same magical effect or spell (except itself), the feathered dragon may grant them a +5 bonus on the first save they make against it.

***Stygian Shield.*** When a creature hits the dragon with a weapon attack from within 30 feet of it, the dragon causes ice to suddenly freeze them. The creature must succeed a DC 26 Constitution saving throw or be restrained for 1 round (or until the start of their next turn). If they take fire damage before then or are immune to cold damage, they are unaffected.

**LEGENDARY ACTIONS (3 ACTIONS)**
***Attack.*** The dragon makes one Claw or Tail attack.
***Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions).*** The dragon beats its wings, spreading flames from its body. Each creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (1d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d12) cold damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.
***Freezing Mists (Costs 3 Actions).*** The dragon fills the area within 30 feet of itself with a thick freezing mist that heavily obscures everything within it, becomes difficult terrain, and lasts until the start of the dragon’s next turn. Any creature that starts their turn in the mist or enters it for the first time takes 8 (2d8) cold damage.
